Children 1 and 2 passed their decoder/runner gates with raw and terminal loss zero. Child 3 had terminal lost samples 4; its raw PERF_RECORD_LOST counter values were 1 and 3 (two records, total 4) and are not added to the terminal count. Children 4--12 were never started.
